documents.title: Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance, achieving an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and value addition per kg of INR 116. The company is executing a composite scheme of arrangement involving the amalgamation of BCPL and the demerger of its copper business into Tieramet Ltd. To support its operations, the company is raising Rs. 52.25 crores through a preferential issue. Additionally, Bhagyanagar India is expanding its capacity to 45,000 MTPA with a planned capex of INR 40 crores for FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% and a 5% increase in prices.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: The government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
demand_outlook.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper consumption will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonne this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin stood at 5.43% in Q1FY27.
The company's value addition per kg was INR 116 in Q1FY27.
The EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: In quarter four, the company achieved around 62 rupees per kg EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonne.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is raising Rs. 52.25 crores through a preferential issue.
Under the scheme of arrangement, BCPL will merge into BIL and be dissolved without winding up.
capital_allocation.quote: BCPL merges into BIL; dissolved without winding up

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Scrap coming from the Gulf region has suddenly dried up, and shipping lines have been diverted.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's dependence on scrap from the Gulf is less than 5% of its material.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are dependent on scrap from Gulf to less than 5% of our material comes from Gulf.
